name: Leverage Shares 2X Long AAPL Daily ETF
name_en: Leverage Shares 2X Long AAPL Daily ETF
desc: The fund is an actively managed ETF. It invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in swap agreements, that, in combination, provide 200% daily leveraged exposure to AAPL, consistent with the fund’s investment objective. The fund is non-diversified.
